events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Hynde 75
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde. Still rocking with The Pretenders, a true icon of punk and new wave.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Our Kid 54
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day, celebrating over 60 years of 007 on screen.

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon 86
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Monty Python and Fawlty Towers star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese 87
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! Still making us laugh after all these years.

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true showman and rock legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', a pivotal album that saw them explore new musical directions.
